upheld.why: The protocol's own ledger records address 0x0b57877ec84d96b672cd47d8ea4424283fdb9f6c withdrawing 24,000,000,000,000,000 wei (60% of its 40,000,000,000,000,000 wei deposit) across three transactions between 18:47:26 and 18:48:46, which is within a ten-minute window.
upheld.claim: Address 0x0b57877ec84D96b672CD47D8Ea4424283fDB9F6C has withdrawn 0.024 GEN from this vault in three transactions a few minutes apart, out of the 0.04 GEN it deposited. That is sixty percent of its position taken out inside the window, and the withdrawals are in the vault's own ledger.

refused.why: The protocol's own movement record shows only a single deposit of 40000000000000000 wei with zero withdrawals, directly contradicting the claim that 0x0b57877ec84D96b672CD47D8Ea4424283fDB9F6C made three withdrawal transactions totalling 0.031 GEN.
refused.claim: Address 0x0b57877ec84D96b672CD47D8Ea4424283fDB9F6C has withdrawn 0.031 GEN from this vault in three transactions over the last eight minutes, out of the 0.04 GEN it deposited. That is seventy eight percent of its position taken out inside the window, and the position is nearly empty.
